school: 十九世纪二十年代'以稳定换定律'的德国电路理论奠基人：锁匠之子，家贫到几度辍学做家庭教师，却在科隆耶稣会中学的实验室里读完拉格朗日与傅里叶；1825 年用不稳定的电堆测出错误的对数律，1826 年听从波根多夫脚注的建议改用温差电偶，电流稳定三十分钟以上——八根导线给出 a/(b+x)，再降温差复测，分子变小而分母不动，他当即称其为'纯粹的自然律'；1827 年《伽伐尼电路的数学论述》以傅里叶热扩散为骨架把电路立成数学理论，'邻近作用'立场直斥超距作用；遭黑格尔派波尔骂作'不治之妄想的产物'并被逐出普鲁士讲席，他辞科隆、留柏林、辗转纽伦堡，把冷板凳坐成讲义，直到 1841 年科普利奖章与 1852 年慕尼黑大学讲席迟到而至；晚年再立声学定律（耳把复合声分解为正弦分音）；电阻单位'欧姆'以他命名（1881 年巴黎国际电学大会，与伏特、安培同批法定）——他证明：定律比承认先到，而承认终会到
historical_significance: 欧姆（Georg Simon Ohm，1789-1854），生于埃尔朗根锁匠世家：父亲约翰·沃尔夫冈是自学成才的大师级锁匠，亲自教两个儿子数学、物理与哲学——格奥尔格与弟弟马丁（后为数学家）史称'欧姆二兄弟'；家贫几度辍学，1806 年赴瑞士 Gottstadt 任数学教师，朗斯多夫劝他自读欧拉、拉普拉斯、拉格朗日；1811 年以《光与色的对立》获埃尔朗根大学博士学位并留校讲授数学，三个学期后因贫困放弃；辗转班贝格等穷学校，1817 年任科隆耶稣会中学数学物理教授——该校实验室与仪器收藏给了他自学的天地，他写信给父亲：'最珍贵的是我几乎被迫亲手制作或修理仪器，没有什么比这更能长进'；1820 年闻知奥斯特与安培，转入电磁研究；1825 年首篇论文（电堆不稳+库仑对数律影响）得出力随长度对数衰减的错误结论，波根多夫在《年鉴》脚注建议改用塞贝克温差效应，欧姆立即采纳：铜-铋温差电偶（沸水-冰水）电流稳定半小时以上，库仑式扭秤读数，八根导线得 a/(b+x)，再降温差复测——分子 a 随激发力缩小而分母 b 不动，他称结果为'纯粹的自然律'：电流与电动势成正比、与总电阻成反比；1826-27 请一年半薪假住柏林弟弟家，1827 年出版《伽伐尼电路的数学论述》——以傅里叶热扩散方程为骨架（圆环近似、无限薄圆盘分割），把'电流从高电势流向低电势'与'热从高温流向低温'咬合为一门数学理论，主张'邻近粒子作用'反对超距作用；黑格尔派物理学家波尔骂其'纯粹幻想之网''不治之妄想的产物'，并说服普鲁士教育部长'宣扬此异端者不配教科学'；欧姆 1828 年辞去科隆教职，在柏林做临时中学教员度日，1833 年任纽伦堡综合理工学校教授；1841 年伦敦皇家学会授科普利奖章（'研究电流诸定律'），惠斯通持续推广，1842 年当选皇家学会外籍会员；1845 年巴伐利亚科学院院士；1849 年任慕尼黑物理陈列馆馆长并开始大学讲课，1852 年终获慕尼黑大学物理讲席（62 岁，终身之愿迟到二十五年）；晚年另立'欧姆声学定律'（1843：耳把复合声分解为正弦分音），与泽贝克激辩并被迫承认推导有误，亥姆霍兹后来支持其结论；1854 年卒于慕尼黑；电阻单位'欧姆'以他命名（1881 年巴黎国际电学大会）——他证明：一个中学教师可以在一间中学实验室里写下整个电气时代的公理，而世界的承认可以迟到十五年，但迟到不等于缺席
historical_significance_en: Georg Simon Ohm (1789-1854), born into a locksmith's family at Erlangen: his father Johann Wolfgang, a master locksmith and remarkable autodidact, personally taught his two sons mathematics, physics and philosophy — Georg and his brother Martin (later a mathematician) went down in history as 'the Ohm brothers'; poverty interrupted his schooling again and again; in 1806 he took a mathematics post at Gottstadt bei Nydau in Switzerland, where Langsdorf advised him to read Euler, Laplace and Lagrange on his own; doctorate from Erlangen in 1811 on a dissertation opposing light to colour, then three poor semesters lecturing before poverty forced him out; through wretched schools at Bamberg until, in 1817, he became teacher of mathematics and physics at the Jesuit Gymnasium of Cologne — whose laboratory and instrument collection opened his self-education, as he wrote his father: 'most precious to me is that I am almost forced to deal with physics, procuring my instruments, even making them myself'; hearing of Ørsted and Ampère in 1820 he turned to electromagnetism; his first paper of 1825, hampered by an unstable pile and misled toward a logarithmic law by Coulomb's example, drew the wrong curve — Poggendorff's footnote in the Annalen suggested Seebeck's thermoelectric effect instead, and Ohm adopted it at once: a copper-bismuth thermocouple (boiling water and ice) held the current steady and strong for over half an hour, a Coulomb-type torsion balance read the 'strength of magnetic action', eight wires yielded a/(b+x), and repeating with a reduced temperature difference shrank the numerator while the denominator held — he called the result 'a pure law of nature': current proportional to electromotive force, inverse to total resistance; a year's leave on half pay (1826-27) at his brother's flat in Berlin produced Die galvanische Kette, mathematisch bearbeitet (1827) — a mathematical theory of the circuit built on Fourier's diffusion equation (the annulus approximation, infinitely thin disks), welding 'current from higher to lower potential' to 'heat from high to low temperature', standing for 'action between contiguous particles' against action at a distance; the Hegelian physicist Pohl damned it as 'a web of naked fancies', 'the product of an incurable delusion whose sole effort is to detract from the dignity of nature', and persuaded the Prussian minister that 'a physicist who professed such heresies was unworthy to teach science'; Ohm resigned Cologne in 1828, scraped by as a temporary schoolteacher in Berlin, took the polytechnic professorship at Nuremberg in 1833; the Royal Society's Copley Medal came in 1841 'for his researches into the laws of electric currents', Wheatstone championed him, foreign membership followed in 1842; Bavarian Academy in 1845; curator at Munich in 1849 with university lectures, and only in 1852 the chair of physics at the University of Munich — the ambition of a lifetime, twenty-five years late; in 1843 he stated his law of physiological acoustics (the ear decomposes complex sounds into sinusoidal partials), fought a bitter controversy with Seebeck and confessed an error in his derivation, with Helmholtz later vindicating the conclusion; he died at Munich in 1854; the ohm, unit of resistance, bears his name (Paris Electrical Congress, 1881) — he proved that a schoolteacher in a school laboratory can write down the axiom of the electrical age, and that the world's recognition may be fifteen years late without being absent
unique_thinking: 欧姆的独特处在于三重'低配高成'：第一，仪器哲学——他不与不稳定的电堆搏斗，而换一个更弱但更稳的电源（温差电偶），以'稳定'换'可靠'，再以'降低温差复测'把变量拆成分子与分母——弱而稳的实验设计胜过强而乱的大装置；第二，移植的数学——他敢于把傅里叶的热扩散骨架整个搬进电学，用类比而不是第一性原理开垦处女地，连'邻近作用'的立场都从傅里叶那里继承；第三，等待的纪律——定律写成之日恰是黑格尔派得势之时，他没有转向、没有自辩成瘾，而是把《数学论述》写成体系、把中学讲义磨成教材，让后人（惠斯通、亥姆霍兹、基尔霍夫）拿着他的公式自己得出结论——他把'被承认'这件最身不由己的事，也做成了方法论的一部分
unique_thinking_en: Ohm's singularity is a triple 'high achievement from low means'. First, a philosophy of instruments: rather than wrestling with the unstable pile he switched to a weaker but steadier source — the thermocouple — trading power for reliability, then repeated the run at a reduced temperature difference so the variables split into numerator and denominator before his eyes: a feeble but stable design beat a strong but chaotic one. Second, transplanted mathematics: he dared to carry Fourier's whole diffusion skeleton into electricity, opening virgin territory by analogy rather than first principles, inheriting even the doctrine of 'contiguous action' from Fourier. Third, the discipline of waiting: the book appeared precisely when the Hegelians held power; he did not swerve, did not addict himself to self-defense, but wrote the Mémoire into a system and ground his school lectures into textbooks, letting the later hands (Wheatstone, Helmholtz, Kirchhoff) reach the verdict themselves with his formula in hand — he made even 'being acknowledged', the least self-governed of affairs, part of his method
civilization_zh: 十九世纪二十年代的科隆与柏林——一个锁匠的儿子在中学实验室里立起电学最普适的定律：他用稳定的温差电偶取代暴躁的电堆，把电流写成电压除以电阻，用傅里叶的数学骨架为电路立法，又在黑格尔派'幻想之网'的咒骂里等了十五年，等到科普利奖章与以他命名的单位——他是证明'最简单的定律往往出身于最寒酸的实验室'的人
civilization_en: Cologne and Berlin in the 1820s — a locksmith's son who raised electricity's most universal law in a secondary-school laboratory: he replaced the tempestuous voltaic pile with a steady thermocouple, wrote current as voltage over resistance, legislated the circuit with Fourier's mathematical skeleton, and waited fifteen years under the Hegelians' curse of 'a web of naked fancies' until the Copley Medal came and a unit took his name — proof that the simplest law is often born in the humblest laboratory

cross_references.description_zh: 欧姆与伏特是'源'的两位改革者：伏特 1800 年发明电堆，给了电学第一个持续电流源；欧姆 1826 年弃用暴躁的电堆改用温差电偶——他不是在造更强的源，而是在造更稳的源，因为定律只能从稳定的源里读出来；两人都相信'仪器先于理论'，但方向相反——伏特靠拼装器件突破（人人可造的电堆），欧姆靠更换器件收敛（恰到好处的温差电偶）——平行命题：实验科学要先用伏特式的源把现象打开，再用欧姆式的源把定律读稳。
cross_references.description_en: Ohm and Volta are two reformers of the 'source': Volta's pile of 1800 gave electricity its first continuous current, while Ohm in 1826 abandoned the tempestuous pile for the thermocouple — not building a stronger source but a steadier one, for only out of a steady source can a law be read; both held that instruments precede theory, though in opposite directions — Volta broke through by assembling devices (a pile anyone could build), Ohm converged by swapping one (a thermocouple just strong enough) — the parallel thesis: an experimental science first opens its phenomena with Volta's kind of source, then reads its laws steady with Ohm's.

cross_references.description_zh: 欧姆与安培共享同一个历史时刻的两半：1820 年奥斯特的发现同时点燃两人，安培冲进去立法'电流之间的作用'（七天冲刺+六年立法），欧姆慢慢测量'电流本身的强度'（五年实验+一本书）；安培把电流当公理用，欧姆把电流当因变量测；差异在于性格与次序——安培先直觉后严格，欧姆先犯错（1825 对数律）后纠错（1826 温差复测）；两人都在 1881 年巴黎大会上得享以自己命名的单位——平行命题：同一发现里，快的人立交互作用的法，慢的人立单变量自身的法。
cross_references.description_en: Ohm and Ampère share two halves of one historical moment: Ørsted's discovery of 1820 fired them both — Ampère rushed in to legislate the action between currents (a seven-day sprint and six years of legislation), Ohm measured slowly the strength of current itself (five years of experiments and one book); Ampère used current as an axiom, Ohm measured it as a dependent variable; the difference lies in temperament and order — Ampère intuited first and formalized after, Ohm erred first (the logarithmic law of 1825) and corrected after (the thermocouple reruns of 1826); both received units of their own at the Paris congress of 1881 — the parallel thesis: within one discovery the swift legislate the interaction, the slow legislate the variable itself.

cross_references.description_zh: 欧姆与高斯走的是同一条数学物理之路的两种命运：两人都信'让数学接管物理'，都以傅里叶式的定量传统立身；但高斯在哥廷根有讲席、有同行、有韦伯，欧姆在普鲁士撞上黑格尔派——高斯的工作当场被读，欧姆的《数学论述》十五年后才被读；高斯的顾虑是'发表前先完美'，欧姆的处境是'发表后先挨骂'——对照命题：数学化物理的命运不取决于数学，而取决于讲席在谁手里。
cross_references.description_en: Ohm and Gauss walked the same road of mathematical physics into two different fates: both believed mathematics should take over physics, both stood on the quantitative tradition of Fourier; but Gauss held a chair at Göttingen with colleagues and Weber, while Ohm in Prussia ran into the Hegelians — Gauss's work was read at once, Ohm's book fifteen years after; Gauss's scruple was to be perfect before publishing, Ohm's lot was to be cursed after publishing — the contrast thesis: the fate of mathematized physics depends not on the mathematics but on whose hands hold the chairs.
